descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，将SLS日志的监控任务`36****`的采集周期修改为`15`秒。返回结果显示，修改监控项成功。
descriptions.en: This topic provides an example on how to change the collection interval of the SLS log monitoring task `36****` to `15` seconds. The response shows that the metric is modified.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms modify-hybrid-monitor-task --task-id 360000 --task-name SLS_task --description SLS_log_monitoring_data. --collect-interval 15 --attach-labels Value=testValue Name=app_service --sls-process-config '{"GroupBy":[{"Alias":"ApiResult","SLSKeyName":"code"}],"Express":[{"Express":"success_count","Alias":"SuccRate"}],"Filter":{"Relation":"and","Filters":[{"Operator":"=","Value":"200","SLSKeyName":"code"}]},"Statistics":[{"Parameter2":"299","Function":"count","Parameter1":"200","Alias":"level_count","SLSKeyName":"name"}]}' --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms ModifyHybridMonitorTask --region cn-hangzhou --SLSProcessConfig.Filter.Filters.1.Value 200 --CollectInterval 15 --TaskId 360000 --Description 'SLS_log_monitoring_data.' --SLSProcessConfig.Express.1.Express success_count --SLSProcessConfig.Filter.Filters.1.Operator '=' --AttachLabels.1.Name app_service --SLSProcessConfig.GroupBy.1.Alias ApiResult --SLSProcessConfig.Express.1.Alias SuccRate --SLSProcessConfig.Statistics.1.Alias level_count --SLSProcessConfig.Statistics.1.Function count --TaskName SLS_task --SLSProcessConfig.Filter.Relation and --SLSProcessConfig.Statistics.1.SLSKeyName name --AttachLabels.1.Value testValue --SLSProcessConfig.Filter.Filters.1.SLSKeyName code --SLSProcessConfig.GroupBy.1.SLSKeyName code --SLSProcessConfig.Statistics.1.Parameter1 200 --SLSProcessConfig.Statistics.1.Parameter2 299 --method POST --force
